name: xiaoqi-pet
description: Xiaoqi desk pet: a companion for ZCode that mirrors live session activity — phases, tools, approval waits and completions — on a desktop pet, with a multi-session task board, color-coded task drawers, desktop notices and a today's-usage / plan-balance capsule.

description_i18n.en: Xiaoqi desk pet: a companion for ZCode that mirrors live session activity — phases, tools, approval waits and completions — on a desktop pet, with a multi-session task board, color-coded task drawers, desktop notices and a today's-usage / plan-balance capsule.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 小栖桌宠：把 ZCode 会话状态（思考、执行工具、等待确认、完成）实时投到桌面宠物上的伴侣，带多会话任务看板、彩色抽屉卡、桌面通知与今日用量 / 套餐余量胶囊。
